An Ordinance to amend an Ordinance approved December 11, 1973, subscribing to the Master Retirement Plan under the Georgia Municipal Employees Benefit System for the employees of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia, and setting forth the joint trust agreement and the contract for the administration of said plan by the Town of Pine Mountain and the Georgia Municipal Employees Benefit System (GMEBS) as provided by 0.C.G.A. #47-5-1 et seq., so as to change the benefit formula; to provide an effective date; to repeal conflicting ordinances; and for other purposes.

BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the authority thereof:
1: Master Retirement Plan of GMEBS for the employees of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia, and setting forth the joint trust agreement and the contract for the administration of said Plan between the Town and the Georgia Municipal Employees Benefit System as provided by 0.C.G.A. #47-5-1 et seq., is hereby amended by striking Section 4 of said ordinance, and substituting in lieu thereof a new Section 4 to read as follows:
2: shall be the product of one and three quarters percent (1 3/4%) of the Participant's final average earnings (as defined by the Master Retirement Plan) multiplied by the Participant's years of credited service (as defined in the Master Retirement Plan).
3: whose employment with the Employer is terminated for any reason whatsoever prior to the effective date of this amendment are fixed and shall be governed by such plan as existed and was in effect at the time of such termination.
5:
hereby expressly repealed.

Ordained this 8th day of September, 1997.

Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia

James V. Edgar, Mayor
